invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.10.0 preserves the locked Parts 1–8 baseline and completes Part 9 PDF / Document Snapshots with immutable issued-invoice payload and PDF archives, SHA-256 integrity hashes, renderer versioning, confirmation-time transactional capture, delivery-to-snapshot lineage, frozen workspace/public/customer-portal PDF reuse, lazy archival for legacy issued invoices, exact-version secure downloads, visible document evidence history, and a read-only company-scoped snapshot resource. Future changes must keep Invoicing, ERP integration, platform closure, app-surface, visibility, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
